verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents documents first-class MCP support. You wrap an MCP server in an `MCPToolset` and pass it to the agent's `tools` parameter, and the GitHub README says MCP server tools integrate with one line of code. That matches the 'one integration grants whole toolsets' core of the story. missing for 10: explicit evidence of attaching or refreshing MCP toolsets dynamically mid-call, independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool calls during a live voice session.
